name: tavernweave-yuri

yuri-card-creator.short_description: Create original yuri cards through conversation
yuri-card-creator.default_prompt: Use $yuri-card-creator to create a complete original yuri card; decide unspecified details and handle the files.

adapt-yuri-card.short_description: Adapt JSON or PNG cards while preserving settings
adapt-yuri-card.default_prompt: Use $adapt-yuri-card to adapt this card into a yuri story, preserving artwork, scripts and unrelated worldbook settings.

post-to-yuri-card.short_description: Turn a supplied post into a source-linked yuri card
post-to-yuri-card.default_prompt: Use $post-to-yuri-card to adapt this post, keeping the poster as {{user}} and new story choices separate from source facts.

novel-excerpt-to-yuri-card.short_description: Adapt selected TXT or EPUB prose into a yuri card
novel-excerpt-to-yuri-card.default_prompt: Use $novel-excerpt-to-yuri-card on one short chapter or scene; retain provenance and let me review the result here.

host_loading: requires user installation and observed skill discovery in a new task
